title: Spec drift sweep: bronze_wgi retry (FR-096), the 'Three checks' contradiction, and the stale unit-test headline
description:
Three false or stale assertions in spec_v1.md, all found by phase-level verification 2026-08-20. MUST route through /iterate per DEC-016 — do NOT edit spec_v1.md directly.

(1) FR-096 (already open in friction.jsonl). Three locations still describe bronze_wgi as retrying at the activity level, which task-075/DEC-018 ended:
  - L642, Stage 1 activity table, Retry column reads `2`. Deployed value is 0 (full live map: Copy 3/300s, bronze_epi 2/30s, bronze_wgi 0/30s, bronze_to_silver_cleaning 2/120s, silver_to_gold 2/120s, data_quality_checks 1/120s, pipeline_error_handler 0/30s).
  - L716, 'Activity-level retry (1-3 retries depending on activity)' — the true range is now 0-3.
  - L1574, Technical Decisions #5, '1-3 retries, i.e. 2-4 total attempts ... 30s for bronze_wgi/bronze_epi'. bronze_wgi keeps the 30s interval but no retries; its budget lives in the notebook (8 bounded attempts).
Every doc under docs/ was correctly swept by task-075 — spec_v1.md is the only stale surface.

(2) NEW, unregistered before this run. L1122 asserts 'Three checks record a non-`pass` row on every run by design — measured, explained and accepted in `docs/data_quality_framework.md § 7`'. That doc's § 7 has opened with 'Two checks record a non-pass row on every pipeline run' since task-069/DEC-016 fixed data_type_consistency on 2026-08-12 (confirmed live on two runs). The spec contradicts the document it cites as its own evidence — a reader hits it the moment they follow the pointer.

(3) L1319 § Testing Strategy reads '**300 tests** ... (measured 2026-08-12)'. Measured 2026-08-20: 340 passed. The as-of date makes this honest rather than false, so re-date rather than treat as a defect. Per-file figures in the same section (data_quality 45, material_mapping 7, country_mapping 18) were re-measured and all hold.

verification_history.notes:
AC1, AC2 and AC4 hold under independent re-derivation; AC3 does not, and the re-date introduced a NEW false claim in the same section.

(1) RETRY MAP re-derived by parsing all 10 activities from pipeline-content.json: Copy x4 = 3/300s, bronze_to_silver_cleaning 2/120s, silver_to_gold 2/120s, data_quality_checks 1/120s, bronze_wgi 0/30s, bronze_epi 2/30s, pipeline_error_handler 0/30s. The three corrected sites match exactly. The correction is strictly better than a number swap: the old '1-3' was ALSO wrong for pipeline_error_handler (0), and '0-3' now covers it. Full spec sweep for retry language (10 hits) found no residue.

(2) AC2 — no Fabric credentials, no live claim made. Structural checks all agree with 'two, not three': bronze_to_silver casts quantity and unitpriceeur to decimal(18,2) at the silver boundary (L530-531) and data_quality_checks' type_consistency_checks still expects 'decimal', so the check is met rather than relabelled; BLOCKING_CHECKS enumerated in full (13 entries, matching spec L1130) contains none of the three; the new text is consistent with the framework doc's opener and disposition table. Independent repo corroboration: task-059 records data_type_consistency = 100.0/pass across FOUR consecutive scheduled runs (2026-08-16/17/18/19). The spec does not over-claim — it names the third check, dates the fix, points at the DEC.

(3) AC3 FAILS. 'uv run pytest tests/' returns 349, so the headline is right. BUT the same section carries 'tests/test_data_quality.py collects **45 tests**', and that file now collects **54**. The section's own convention says counts are measured against the date on the Unit Tests line — so moving that date to 2026-08-21 RE-CERTIFIED 45 as current. It was correct under the 2026-08-12 stamp and became wrong at HEAD ba0cd91 (+9 tests). The 340->349 delta the pass measured IS that same +9, so the correct figure was observable at measurement time. The edit turned an honestly-dated number into a falsely-dated one inside the very section it was refreshing — the failure mode this task exists to eliminate, one line below the line it fixed.

(4) AC4 — FR-096 resolved with the three locations named; register 20 open of 98.

(5) INDEX FRESHNESS verified by regeneration, not inspection: fingerprint.py --index to a temp file is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed index, and its spec_fingerprint equals the live --spec hash.

(6) DEC-018 and DEC-019 both carry spec_revised: true + spec_revised_date: 2026-08-21.

(7) VERIFICATION-RESULT ANNOTATION overreaches. 'verified_against' correctly names the OLD fingerprint and the text disclaims asserting the new one — the specific thing it was told not to do, it does not do. But 'The BUILD did not change' and 'stale on fingerprint only' were written AFTER HEAD ba0cd91 modified fabric/silver_to_gold.Notebook (+72 lines) and fabric/bronze_ingest_wgi.Notebook — i.e. after the 2026-08-20 phase pass, whose own summary rested on 'the artifact set at HEAD is byte-identical to what scheduled run c5ad962d ran'. A reader could decline re-verification on a premise that is no longer true.

Two doc surfaces outside declared scope still contradict the corrected spec (issues 3 and 4); both need a normal doc edit, not /iterate. All negative findings produced with /usr/bin/grep plus a positive control in the SAME command.
